---

## Executive Summary

The exact candidate commit `c4b8c9be292f06a5c593362b5d655169144ff007` evaluated two discrete components:
1. A provider-free read-only review of the current `confirmAppointmentDeleteProposal` delete-confirm route against the accepted unmounted physical transaction seam.
2. An Ariadne repository continuation control resolving structured full lowercase Git commit IDs before passing continuation receipts.

While the Ariadne Git-object resolution harness, preflight CLI integration, Ruff linter, and whitespace check all executed cleanly with exit code 0, the deterministic route review test suite (`ROUTE_REVIEW_TESTS`) failed with exit code 1 due to a SHA-256 bound source hash mismatch on `docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-status-confirm-route-mounting-admission-review.md`.

In accordance with the frozen verification criteria requiring all frozen product and harness input hashes and all focused test suites to pass deterministically, the candidate requires revision.

## Detailed Findings

### 1. Route Review Source Hash Mismatch (`ROUTE_REVIEW_TESTS`)
- **Allowlisted Path:** [docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-status-confirm-route-mounting-admission-review.md](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/review-delete-confirm-convergence-c4b8c9be/docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-status-confirm-route-mounting-admission-review.md)
- **Affecting Artifacts:**
  - [orchestration/continuity/raisa-delete-confirm-route-convergence-and-ariadne-git-object-resolution/route-convergence-contract.json](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/review-delete-confirm-convergence-c4b8c9be/orchestration/continuity/raisa-delete-confirm-route-convergence-and-ariadne-git-object-resolution/route-convergence-contract.json#L21)
  - [docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-delete-confirm-route-convergence-and-ariadne-git-object-resolution-plan.md](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/review-delete-confirm-convergence-c4b8c9be/docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-delete-confirm-route-convergence-and-ariadne-git-object-resolution-plan.md#L85)
  - [scripts/raisa_provider_free_read_only_delete_confirm_route_convergence_review.py](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/review-delete-confirm-convergence-c4b8c9be/scripts/raisa_provider_free_read_only_delete_confirm_route_convergence_review.py#L98-L101)
- **Observed Error:**
  ```text
  scripts.raisa_provider_free_read_only_delete_confirm_route_convergence_review.ReviewError: bound source hash mismatch: docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-status-confirm-route-mounting-admission-review.md
  ```
- **Analysis:**
  `scripts/raisa_provider_free_read_only_delete_confirm_route_convergence_review.py` validates SHA-256 digests of all 18 bound input sources against `route-convergence-contract.json`. The expected digest recorded in the contract (`c82a96d7ddc241f9526bbb36578bf7a8f21a0dd5b373dda3406d680e4aee79f0`) fails validation against the file contents on disk. Consequently:
  - `test_exact_read_only_route_review_passes` raises `ReviewError` during evaluation.
  - `test_verdict_cannot_ignore_a_blocker` fails due to encountering the hash mismatch error before reaching the verdict validation assertions.

---

## Evaluation of Evaluated Dimensions & Controls

1. **Delete-Confirm Route Matrix (Conceptual):**
   - The route classification logic properly identifies 3 satisfied dimensions (`literal_mounting`, `raw_delete_isolation`, `serial_postgresql_foundation`), 1 partial gap (`canonical_identity_and_alias`), and 6 blocking gaps (`physical_seam_composition`, `server_authority_ingress`, `locked_proposal_readmission`, `atomic_effect_audit_receipt`, `response_contract_compatibility`, `stored_delivery_and_http_mapping`).
   - The mapped verdict `unmounted_adapter_and_response_transition_required` is structurally sound, but cannot be validated by the deterministic runner until the bound source hash is aligned.

2. **Ariadne Git-Object Resolution (`ARIADNE_RESOLUTION_TESTS`):**
   - [orchestration_harness/git_object_resolution.py](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/review-delete-confirm-convergence-c4b8c9be/orchestration_harness/git_object_resolution.py) correctly enforces:
     - 40-character lowercase hexadecimal regular expression filtering.
     - Fixed `git` command invocation with `shell=False` and strict timeouts.
     - Byte-exact resolution via `<id>^{commit}` and verification against `cat-file -t commit`.
     - Ancestry validation against machine-observed full `HEAD` via `git merge-base --is-ancestor`.
     - Closed typed failure projections that narrow receipt outcomes to `revision_required` and prevent worker dispatch.
   - All 35 tests across `test_ariadne_git_object_resolution.py`, `test_ariadne_orchestrator_preflight.py`, `test_ariadne_active_operation_latch.py`, and `test_ariadne_risk_weighted_workflow.py` passed.

---

## Required Remediation

1. Recalculate and update the exact SHA-256 hash for [docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-status-confirm-route-mounting-admission-review.md](file:///C:/Users/sarashera/EMR4-worktrees/review-delete-confirm-convergence-c4b8c9be/docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-status-confirm-route-mounting-admission-review.md) across:
   - `orchestration/continuity/raisa-delete-confirm-route-convergence-and-ariadne-git-object-resolution/route-convergence-contract.json`
   - `orchestration/continuity/raisa-delete-confirm-route-convergence-and-ariadne-git-object-resolution/provider-free-read-only-evidence.json`
   - `docs/raisa-provider-free-read-only-delete-confirm-route-convergence-and-ariadne-git-object-resolution-plan.md`
2. Re-run `ROUTE_REVIEW_TESTS` to verify that `test_exact_read_only_route_review_passes` and `test_verdict_cannot_ignore_a_blocker` both exit with code 0.
